scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-sikander "npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/firestore.rules.lattice-dedicated-view-invariants.test.ts tests/firestore.rules.test.ts tests/firestore.rules.d1-phase2a.test.ts tests/firestore.rules.d1-phase2b.test.ts tests/firestore.rules.p1-phase3d.test.ts tests/firestore.rules.d4-phase4a.test.ts tests/persistence.repositories.test.ts tests/persistence.runtime-mode.test.ts tests/audit-f01-production-persistence.e2e.test.ts tests/f03.persistence-rollback.test.ts"
scripts.test:f02-console-auth: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-sikander "npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/audit-f02-console-functions-auth.e2e.test.ts"
scripts.test:f02-functions-http: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-sikander "FIREBASE_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:15001 npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/audit-f02-functions-http-emulator.e2e.test.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:console-auth: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-sikander "FIREBASE_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:15001 bash scripts/e2e-console-auth.sh"
scripts.mutation:documents: stryker run stryker.documents.config.mjs && node scripts/check-mutation-per-file.mjs stryker.documents.config.mjs
